events.event_name: Bobbi Brown The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th St and W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation for Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ with product sampling, a mirrored photo moment, morning treats and scratch-off giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Visitors can receive a Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ sample, a grapefruit-infused Spindrift and mini croissant while supplies last. Scratch-off cards unlock additional giveaways, with select winners receiving a full-size product.
events.caveats: Two current event listings agree on the date, time, location and open-public format. No advance RSVP requirement is stated. Samples, food/drink and prizes are promotional inventory and may run out; scratch-off prizes are not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle on 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets. Walk-in public activation; arrive earlier if samples or giveaways are the priority.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first public café-and-retail pop-up, built around the Mocha Magic fragrance launch with complimentary coffee/snacks, fragrance sampling, exclusive merchandise and shopping.
events.what_is_free: Public entry is free. DedCool says the pop-up will serve free coffee and snacks, and current event listings advertise Mocha Magic fragrance sampling. The first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift.
events.caveats: DedCool's founder told Glossy the pop-up is open to everyone. A free Partiful RSVP is available, but current evidence does not establish RSVP as mandatory. The special daily gift is first-come for the first 50 people in line; other merchandise and gifts may have separate purchase or inventory conditions.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott Street. RSVP is useful for planning, but public walk-in access is explicitly supported by current reporting.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-themed pop-up with Apothékary tincture sampling, tongue readings, ingredient education, kakigori and a storewide event promotion.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture. Visitors can sample the tincture range and get kakigori while supplies last. A free RSVP is available through Eventbrite.
events.caveats: Eventbrite currently lists the event as an Apothékary-organized in-person event at 1542 3rd Avenue with multiple dates. NYC for FREE independently lists the same date-specific hours and describes the admission as free. First-50 gifts and kakigori are while supplies last; the 20% discount and gift-with-purchase are purchase-linked benefits, not conditions of entry.
events.practical_notes: September 18 runs 1–9 PM; September 19 and 20 run 9 AM–9 PM. Use the live Eventbrite page for the current free RSVP and date selection.
